title: Two-Stage Multi-modal Learning for Dynamic Audio-Visual Navigation: From Physical Alignment to Scene Aggregation
abstract: arXiv:2610.14077v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Embodied Audio-Visual Navigation (AVN) requires an agent to locate sound targets by jointly leveraging visual and auditory cues. While prior work has achieved notable success with static sound sources, real-world scenarios often involve moving targets, giving rise to the more challenging problem of \textbf{Dynamic Audio-Visual Navigation (D-AVN)}. Existing approaches largely rely on semantic auditory features, which limits generalization to unheard sound categories and hinders fine-grained spatial reasoning. To address these challenges, we propose a novel \textbf{Two-Stage Multi-modal Learning} framework for D-AVN. In the Physical Alignment stage, the proposed \textbf{Intensity-Calibrated Geometry Encoder (ICGE)} performs physics-informed alignment of sound intensity with visual geometry to capture category-agnostic spatial correspondence. In the Scene Aggregation stage, a Transformer-based \textbf{Cross-Modal Scene Aggregator (CMSA)}

translated_title: 面向动态视听导航的两阶段多模态学习：从物理对齐到场景聚合
translated_abstract: 具身视听导航（AVN）要求智能体通过联合利用视觉和听觉线索来定位声源目标。尽管先前的工作在静态声源方面取得了显著成功，但现实世界的场景往往涉及移动目标，由此产生了更具挑战性的动态视听导航（D-AVN）问题。现有方法主要依赖语义听觉特征，这限制了对未听过声音类别的泛化能力，并阻碍了细粒度的空间推理。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的面向D-AVN的两阶段多模态学习框架。在物理对齐阶段，所提出的强度校准几何编码器（ICGE）将声音强度与视觉几何进行基于物理信息的对齐，以捕获类别无关的空间对应关系。在场景聚合阶段，基于Transformer的跨模态场景聚合器（CMSA）
tldr: 提出了一种面向动态视听导航的两阶段多模态学习框架，通过强度校准几何编码器实现声音强度与视觉几何的物理对齐，并结合跨模态场景聚合器，摆脱了对语义听觉特征的依赖，提升了对未听过声音类别的泛化能力和细粒度空间推理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-stage multi-modal learning framework for dynamic audio-visual navigation that combines physics-informed intensity-geometry alignment (ICGE) with Transformer-based cross-modal scene aggregation (CMSA), overcoming reliance on semantic auditory features to improve generalization to unheard sound categories and fine-grained spatial reasoning.
